event_summary: A small brown top-shaped object enters from the left, moves across the tabletop in front of a stationary white block, and exits at the right.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a light wood-grain tabletop, a white textured rectangular block near the upper center, and a partially visible black circular object at the left edge. After a period with no visible scene-object motion, a small brown top-shaped object appears from the lower left area, travels rightward across the tabletop below the white block, remains visibly blurred during the traverse, and leaves the frame on the right. The white block, tabletop, and black left-edge object remain in the same visible positions throughout.

reasons: The tabletop and stationary white block are visible before the moving brown object appears.
The moving brown object is not yet visible in the first frame.
